source.note: Wave-1 row 39 named Quaternius Low Poly Sea Animals via the poly.pizza CDN (behind a Cloudflare challenge). This is the OpenGameArt copy of the same Quaternius dolphin: the Animated Fish pack (CC0; the same zip and sha256 pin as the koi), member FBX/Dolphin.fbx. Its only clip is Swim (an up-and-down body and fluke stroke). Coloured on the indigo script: a deep blue back (#1b2d6b, shade #16141c) over a pale blue-white belly (#e7eefc, shade #d5e2ff), so it reads as a dolphin and stays apart from a grey shark. Height 0.8 m (dorsal fin tip to flipper tips) gives a 2.48 m body, a bottlenose dolphin's length. A dolphin has no ground: like every entry its lowest rest point is at y = 0; films lift it into the water.

Swim.sinkAllowed: a swimmer has no ground: the flippers and flukes dip up to 38 mm below the rest floor in the stroke; films lift it into the water, and clamping would add a false bob
